title: al-Ḥayawānāt · Animals
sub: Allāh made every one of them

words.say: Point and say qiṭṭah 5× — then: be gentle, the Prophet ﷺ loved cats
words.deen: kindness to animals is a good deed

words.say: Moo together, then: Allāh made the baqarah — she gives us milk
words.deen: Sūrah al-Baqarah is named after the cow

words.say: Baa like the kharūf — then: we follow the sheep at ʿĪd al-Aḍḥā
words.deen: the sunnah of Uḍḥiyah

words.say: Clip-clop around the room — horses were loved by the Prophet ﷺ
words.deen: teach your son swimming, archery and riding

words.say: Look up: subḥānAllāh! — the birds bow to Allāh too
words.deen: every bird prays to Allāh (al-Anʿām 6:38)

words.say: Swim your hand like a samakah — who taught it to swim? Allāh
words.deen: Yūnus ʿalayhi as-salām and the great fish

words.say: Say tuffāḥ, take a bite: qurʾīsh— crumple the sound, make it fun
words.deen: fruits are a gift of Jannah

words.say: Peel it slowly — say mawz at every piece, alḥamdulillāh after
words.deen: banana trees grow in Jannah (al-Wāqiʿah 56:29)

words.say: The sunnah fruit! Odd number, right hand: bismillāh
words.deen: the Prophet ﷺ broke his fast with tamr

words.say: One ʿinab for him, one for you — sharing is sunnah
words.deen: rivers of wine in Jannah are compared to grapes

words.say: Cut, share, say baṭṭīkh — red inside, green outside, subḥānAllāh
words.deen: the Prophet ﷺ ate melon with dates

words.say: Roll it, smell it, say burtuqāl — then share the segments
words.deen: give sadaqah: one segment for someone else

title: al-Alwān · Colours
sub: Find them all in your house

words.say: Find 3 aḥmar things in the room — a ball, a cushion, his cup
words.deen: the honoured black stone of the Kaʿbah was once bright

words.say: Green is the colour of Jannah — find akhḍar in the park
words.deen: the garments of the people of Jannah are green

words.say: Find aṣfar: a banana, the sun, a lemon — say it every time
words.deen: the sun is one of Allāh's signs

words.say: Point at the sky: the biggest azraq thing Allāh made
words.deen: the sky above is a ceiling Allāh raised

words.say: Find aswad: night sky, his shoes, the Kaʿbah's cloth
words.deen: the Kaʿbah wears a black kiswah

words.say: Wear abyaḍ on Jumuʿah — find white things at home
words.deen: white clothes are the sunnah of the Prophet ﷺ

words.say: Blink game, then: Allāh made my ʿayn — alḥamdulillāh!
words.deen: close the eyes when the adhāb of the washroom comes

words.say: Whisper his name — my udhn hears! — now it hears Qurʾān
words.deen: the ear will be asked what it listened to

words.say: Sniff-sniff! My anf smells the biryani — alḥamdulillāh
words.deen: smell a flower and say subḥānAllāh

words.say: My fam says bismillāh, says āmīn, says māmā
words.deen: good words are sadaqah

words.say: High-five the yad! — my hand gives salām, my hand helps
words.deen: the upper hand (the giver) is better

words.say: Stomp-stomp the qadam — one day it will walk to the masjid
words.deen: feet that walk to the masjid are guarded by Allāh

words.say: Knock-knock on the bāb — say salām when you enter the room
words.deen: say the duʿāʾ of entering the home

words.say: Tuck in, right side, three Qul over him on his sarīr
words.deen: the Prophet's ﷺ bedtime sunnah

words.say: Drink from the kūb in three sips, sitting down
words.deen: drinking sitting down is sunnah

words.say: Hold the milʿaqah himself — messy is how he learns
words.deen: eat with the right hand, alḥamdulillāh after

words.say: Sit on the kursīy for story time — 5 minutes a day
words.deen: the Kursīy of Allāh is greater than all the skies

words.say: His own sajjādah beside yours — he copies your sujūd
words.deen: a child of the masjid before he can walk

words.say: Vroom! Say sayyārah — in the car we say the travel duʿāʾ
words.deen: subḥāna lladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā

words.say: The wheels on the ḥāfilah go round — count the people, alḥamdulillāh
words.deen: Allāh carried Nūḥ's people on the ark

words.say: Choo-choo! Line up cushions like the qiṭār and ride
words.deen: sulaimān had a procession like none after him

words.say: Arms out, fly! Who keeps the ṭāʾirah in the sky? Allāh
words.deen: one day, in shāʾ Allāh, flying for ḥajj

words.say: Pedal the darrājah with help — balance, then freedom
words.deen: teach your son to ride and swim

words.say: Bathtub safīnah! Who floats it? Allāh made the water hold it
words.deen: Nūḥ's ark — the first famous ship

words.say: Point to Ummī — kiss her hand, Jannah is under her feet
words.deen: your mother, your mother, then your father

words.say: Abī carries me, prays with me — my first imām
words.deen: a father's good upbringing is a gift to his child

words.say: He is the ṭifl! Be soft with babies — gentleness is sunnah
words.deen: the Prophet ﷺ shortened prayer when a baby cried

words.say: Video-call Jaddah on Sunday — salām first, always
words.deen: the Prophet ﷺ was raised with the love of a grandmother

words.say: Jadd's lap is a throne — tell him: JazākAllāh
words.deen: honouring elders is from ikhrām of Allāh

words.say: Share one biscuit with your akh — one for you, one for him
words.deen: believers are brothers (al-Ḥujurāt 49:10)

words.say: The house of Allāh — we whisper inside and love to go
words.deen: take him to the masjid from babyhood

words.say: Kiss it, place it high — Allāh's words to us
words.deen: the best of you learns and teaches Qurʾān

words.say: The black cube in Makkah — we turn to it in every ṣalāh
words.deen: the qiblah of every prayer

words.say: His little ṭāqīyah — put it on and stand with Abī
words.deen: like a mini imām beside you

words.say: One bead, one subḥānAllāh — his fingers learn dhikr early
words.deen: dhikr after every ṣalāh, 33 each

words.say: Find the hilāl at the month's start — new month, new duʿāʾ
words.deen: the moon marks Ramaḍān and the two ʿĪds
